column1: # THE HOUSEHOLD OF GILBERTO LERENA AND JULIA SALVANACH - assembled 14 September 2026.
# Searched on GILBERTO AS FATHER across the Argentine collections, which had never been done here.
# Index-level unless a row says otherwise; the surname is spelled Salvanach, Salvanak, Salbanach,
# Salvanach, Salvanach, Salvanach, Selvanach, Sebanach and Salvanach across these records.
# *** WHY IT MATTERS. *** Gilberto was documented on 13-14 September as the BROTHER of Luis Eugenio
# Lerena Lenguas - two acts, two parishes, two hands. So this is a DOCUMENTED LERENA FAMILY IN
# ARGENTINA descending from the Montevideo house, and Juan Carlos Lerena had to come from somewhere.

column1: # *** THE MOVE IS NOW BRACKETED BY BAPTISMS, not inferred from census birthplaces. ***
# The LAST child baptised at Montevideo is Maria Angelica Julia, 31 OCTOBER 1886.
# The FIRST child baptised at Buenos Aires is Maria Carlota, 29 OCTOBER 1890.
# So the family crossed the river between OCTOBER 1886 and OCTOBER 1890. This archive has said
# "between 1887 and 1889", read off the switch in census birthplaces; the baptisms are firmer and
# slightly wider, and they are records of the family rather than of its children's stated origins.
# *** AND JUAN CARLOS LERENA IS NOT AMONG THEM. *** Eight children of this marriage are now named
# and he is none of them. That matters because this was the best remaining place to put him: a
# Lerena household of the right surname, in the right country, at the right time, descending from
# the one Uruguayan house this archive has documented.
